The source provides a data-inclusion rule for the outreach tab and does not change the expectation to execute routine work independently.
The source does not change how completed subtasks or goal parent tasks are maintained in ClickUp.
The Airbnb outreach-tab rule is unrelated to CJ Dropshipping product research and selection.
The source does not affect Shopify publication destinations, listing sequence, categories, or product counts.
The source does not affect TikTok Shop product publication or any of its listing rules.
The source modifies Airbnb lead inclusion and does not change the content-bank artifact, use, or deadline.
